Garidmagnai "bLitz" Byambasuren (born June 26, 2001) is a Mongolian professional Counter-Strike 2 player and a former Counter-Strike: Global Offensive player.

Trivia

[edit]
  • Is also a Top 20 rated Chess player in Mongolia, holding the title of FIDE Master. [2]
  • He is still playing tournaments in 2021, finished 9th in FIDE World Blitz Championship 2021 Mongolian Qualifiers. [3]
